name: Vahlarriel's Search
summary: In Desolace, Vahlarriel Demonslayer searches for two missing nobles of House Malem. Their father fears the worst, and the siblings were last reported crossing the Stonetalon Mountains some weeks ago. Vahlarriel asks you to find their wagon.

sections.title: Two Missing Nobles
sections.body: Vahlarriel Demonslayer seeks Tyranis and Dalinda Malem. Their father has charged Vahlarriel with doing everything possible to find them. The search has only begun, and Vahlarriel hopes it will not keep them in Desolace long. The siblings were last reported crossing the Stonetalon Mountains some weeks ago. You are asked to find their wagon in Desolace and return at once. Its charred remains lie there, with a chest among them.

sections.title: Among the Wreckage
sections.body: The wreck bears marks left by spells and weapons. The fight seems brief and one-sided, yet no blood or bodies remain. Whoever struck was swift and efficient.

faq.answer: Vahlarriel seeks Tyranis and Dalinda Malem, two nobles of House Malem, a Darnassian merchant family.

faq.q: Where were the siblings last heard from?
faq.answer: Crossing the Stonetalon Mountains, some weeks ago, by the last report.
Their father fears the worst. He has charged Vahlarriel with doing everything possible to find his missing children.

faq.q: What does Vahlarriel want you to find?
faq.answer: Vahlarriel asks you to find Tyranis and Dalinda Malem's wagon in Desolace and return at once if you find it.
